bibl.title: P. Kellis I 82 and an Unnoticed Record of the Manichaean Daily Prayers.
bibl.seg: 364 Astronomica et Astrologia Calendaria Manichaeorum Libri
Iain Gardner, P. Kellis I 82 and an Unnoticed Record of the Manichaean Daily Prayers.
bibl.note: P. Kellis Gr. I, 92 (= LDAB 109540). At ll. 36-38 on the back, not "the start of an invocation of a god, a daemon vel sim.", but the characteristic opening phrase of the Manichaean Daily Prayers.
